Rounded to the **nearest tenth**, the area of $△ABC$ is{{field-1}} ${\text{ft}}^{2}.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The formula for the area of the triangle is 

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}bc\operatorname{sin}⁡A,
$$

where $∠A$ is between the sides of lengths $b$ and $c.$ 

Here, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}с & =AB=18, \\ b & =AC=12, \\ m∠A & ={120}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since 

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡{120}^{∘}=0.866\,025,
$$

rounded to six decimal places,  we calculate the area as follows:
 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 12\cdot 18\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{120}^{∘} \\  & =108\cdot (0.866\,025…) \\  & ≈93.5\,{\text{ft}}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the **nearest tenth**.
